9.7 AIR QUALITY
The Applicant proposes to dispose of vegetative material during land clearing operations by burning and disposal at land fills, and would follow State and local regulations regarding open burning. In order to control smoke associated with the burning of vegetative material, the FPC Staff believes that the Applicant should consider the use of an air curtain destructor to minimize the amount of smoke and particulate matter emitted into the air from the burning.
